Hello The Origin Play School team,

I'm Janani, and I build websites for playschools and preschools in Chennai. I was looking at theoriginplayschool.com this week. On a phone, a settings icon sits on top of your headline and cuts off the first letters, and the button still says “Admission Open 2024-2025”. So I rebuilt it, using your own photos and details. Here's how it looks today and how it could look, on a computer and on a phone:

Open it on your phone and scroll slowly. It opens on your bright classroom with the colourful shelves, then brings up your festival costumes, yoga on the mats and the tricolour hands, ending with a button to book a school visit on WhatsApp.

Why this matters now: AI search. More and more people skip Google and simply ask ChatGPT, Gemini or Google's AI answers for “a playschool in Adambakkam”. These assistants recommend the businesses whose websites clearly tell them who you are, where you are and what you offer. Right now theoriginplayschool.com doesn't give these tools your business details in a form they can read, like most websites built a few years ago. Your new website is built for it: your details are written in the standard format AI tools read (schema.org), it has a clear question-and-answer section, and an llms.txt file made for AI assistants.
